name: @gnosia/catalog
//exports: No build step, same as @gnosia/schema: the consumers are tsx, vitest and Next (which lists this package in transpilePackages), and all three compile the TypeScript directly. Only ./state is exported, because that is the only part the web app has any business importing — the indexers, the migrations and the CLI are the catalog's own, and a page reaching for them would be the layering violation ARCHITECTURE.md rule 10 exists to prevent.
